messages:
Kavita: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — creating a single thread to track owners/timelines for the KV-cache memory leak & recent OOMs. I'll list action items below and ping owners. TL;DR: profiling, soft-limits, GC tuning, fragmentation spikes, and regression alerts.

Jin: thanks — drop the action list and I’ll take profiling (flamegraphs + alloc traces).

Kavita: Action items: 1) Allocation profiling (heap + shard hist) — owner: Jin — due: 2026-03-30 — deliverable: flamegraphs + hotspot README. 2) Soft-limit + eviction canary — owner: Lena — due: 2026-04-06 — deliverable: canary config + perf matrix. 3) GC policy adjustments + dashboard — owner: Aj — due: 2026-04-01 — deliverable: config diff + SLO impact. 4) Fragmentation mitigation spike (slab tuning + periodic compaction) — owner: Maria — due: 2026-04-08 — deliverable: bench + regression notes. 5) Regression detection alert + eval set — owner: SRE-Oncall — due: 2026-03-28 — deliverable: alert + test prompt set. Please sync to INF-4829 and update progress there.

Jin: Ack. Plan: start a low-traffic sampling job with allocator tracer for 3h at ~50% traffic, collect flamegraphs, and attach to this thread. Any special flags I should set?

Lena: For the eviction canary I propose soft_limit=0.8 + aggressive_eviction=true on blue-canary group. Will run for 24h and capture token cost + p95 latency. Anyone object? :thinking_face:

Aj: No objections. Add a rollback guard: if p95 latency increases by > 20% or p95 > 200ms, rollback. I'll post the fallback policy and config diff.

SRE-Oncall: I'll own the alerting. Proposed composite signal: (a) residency increase over 6h > 10% relative to baseline, (b) any OOM count > 0 on a host within 10m, (c) alloc-hotspot delta above x. Implementing as composite alert with a 5m aggregation window.

Maria: On fragmentation: I'll try slab-size doubling + periodic compaction every 30m in staging. CPU cost is a risk; benching first. If staging looks good I’ll run a canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary shard blue-canary created: canary_id=canary-4521 by Lena at 1755554360

Kavita: Notes: add regression tests that emulate long-running chat + kv growth. Jin — please ensure traces include trace IDs so SRE can correlate. Also add a short README for how to reproduce locally.

Jin: Will do. Sampling job queued (job id 8842), will attach flamegraphs and raw traces to this thread once available.

Lena: Starting canary now. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/dashboards/blue-canary — will post periodic updates.

SRE-Oncall: Alert created: PMEM-KV-RESIDENCY-DETECT. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/kv-residency. I’ll add the eval prompt set and a synthetic job to exercise growth patterns.

Kavita: Weekly progress sync scheduled Fri 10:00am — calendar invite sent. Please keep INF-4829 updated with status, links, and PRs.

Maria: I’ll have staging benchmark numbers by 2026-04-05 and a short risk assessment.

Aj: I’ll post the GC config diff and tests by EOD tomorrow.

Jin: Flamegraphs will be attached here once job finishes (ETA ~3h).

Kavita: Closing ask: if anyone sees regressions while experimenting, call it out in this thread and tag @SRE-Oncall + @Kavita. Thanks all — let’s get these remediations into the next sprint. :white_check_mark:
